svg.text: ZK Rollup Voting System — End-to-End Architecture
Privacy-preserving on-chain voting · Two-layer Groth16 zero-knowledge rollup · Ethereum L1

g.text: Voter secret stays on device — operator only sees (nullifier, candidate)
16 votes → 1 on-chain proof verification (~constant gas per batch)
Two-layer ZK: per-vote eligibility + batched state-transition proof
On-chain nullifier registry — rejected client-side AND on-chain
All roots & batches on-chain — tally fully reproducible
